bot.f3: Structured knowledge transfer for your engineering teams.

whyXarka.heading: Infrastructure you control. Outcomes you can defend.
whyXarka.subtitle: Composable architecture, rigorous security, and deployment flexibility—without compromising on sovereignty or long-term ownership.

p1.title: Self-hosted infrastructure
p1.subtitle: Your premises. Your stack.
p1.desc: On-premises deployment with optional air-gapped operation. Proprietary models from 4B to 1T parameters with independently upgradeable OCR, embedding, and LLM layers.

p2.title: Enterprise security
p2.subtitle: ISO 27001 · ISO 42001 · SOC 2 · GDPR
p2.desc: Encryption at rest and in transit with client-managed keys. Comprehensive audit trails for every inference and data access event.

p3.title: Sovereign AI
p3.subtitle: Built and governed in India
p3.desc: Indian-origin models aligned with national AI strategy and data localization requirements—designed for government, defense, and critical infrastructure.

p4.title: Modular architecture
p4.subtitle: Deploy only what you need
p4.desc: OCR, embeddings, text LLM, or the full stack—composed to your requirements. From single-server pilots to multi-node production clusters.

p5.title: Custom fine-tuning
p5.subtitle: Your data. Your model.
p5.desc: Domain-specific fine-tuning on proprietary datasets with dedicated engineering support through deployment and knowledge transfer.

p6.title: Hardware agnostic
p6.subtitle: No accelerator lock-in
p6.desc: Runs on NVIDIA GPUs and compatible accelerators. Scale on cloud, on-premise, or hybrid with optimized inference pipelines.
